excerpt.zh: 我们有句老话：‘任何事情都有可能发生；这也包括无事发生这件事。’很不幸，我们的冥想没能获得任何见解。
excerpt.en: A saying is known to us: 'Everything that can happen will; even nothing.' Unfortunately, our meditations have failed to produce any insight.
